arStrings.szText:
{c_red}Andariel{/c} has taken hold in The Kurast Undercity.
Beware of her ambushes. Find and utilize {c_rare}Andariel's Tributes{/c} when starting a run to increase your chances of encountering her. {c_highlight}Return her Corrupted Essences to Hadriel{/c} to unlock Divine Gifts.
